task_prompt: You are given the following quantum programming task. Implement Grover search in Q# for the 4-qubit marked state |1110>: write the oracle as a phase flip, the diffusion via within/apply, and a Python driver verifying the success rate over 500 shots. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
